slides.text: No idea what to post today? *Film this*

slides.top: A 5 minute Reel any business can post today

slides.text: Film 5 to 8 seconds of something ordinary: your product, your desk, your finished work.
Add one line on screen: "This is your sign to" + the thing you sell or fix.
Photographer: "This is your sign to book fall photos before the leaves drop."
Cleaner: "This is your sign to come home to a clean house on Friday."
Clothing shop: "This is your sign to own one outfit that's just for doing nothing."

items: One "This is your sign to" line

caption: The $1K Challenge gives you 25 Reel ideas like this every week, ready to film. Link in bio. This one works on a busy day because it takes one ordinary clip and one line. Swap in what you sell, keep the line short enough to read in two seconds, and end on the step you want people to take.
